milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mined spruce logs drop as items and end up in the player's inventory. The player starts with no spruce_logs (only an iron_axe), so any spruce_log in inventory confirms mining occurred. min_count=2 ensures the player has gathered enough raw material (2 logs = 8 planks) for the downstream trapdoor recipe requiring 6 planks.

Uses inventory_has because the crafted spruce_trapdoor ends up in the player's inventory and is not present in the starting inventory or scene. The recipe (6 spruce_planks in 2 rows of 3 on a crafting table) yields 2 trapdoors; requiring min_count=1 confirms at least one successful craft.
